birthdays.label: Birthdays
birthdays.description: Wish members a happy birthday (message + role of the day).

opt.targetMember: Set for another member (admin: Manage Server).

birthdays.noPermission: ❌ You don't have permission to manage another member's birthday.

channelId.label: Announcement channel
channelId.help: The channel where birthdays are wished. Empty, nothing is announced: dates keep being recorded, but nobody sees them go by.

roleId.label: “Birthday of the day” role
roleId.help: A role the member wears for their birthday, then removed automatically. Giving it a colour makes them stand out in the member list. It must sit below the bot's role to be grantable.

announceHour.label: Announcement hour (0-23)
announceHour.help: The hour of the announcement, in the **bot's** timezone, not the member's. A server whose community lives elsewhere should shift it: at 9am server time, part of the members are still asleep.

announceMinute.label: Announcement minute (0-59)
announceMinute.help: The minute of the announcement. The bot checks once a minute: at 9:00, every birthday of the day goes out together.
